content:
sasha: Quick update 1: interview with BeaconEdge finished. They gave a really concise hero line and are ok with a logo, but want an embargo until next Wed. Need legal checkbox + signed permission.

jo: Hero soundbite: "Redwood made our multi-region deployments predictable 1 we cut incident work and halved median tail latency." Keeper?

kevin: Love it. I'll craft a 2-sentence teaser and a short narrative for the blog + social cards. Planning to include a 30s audio clip in the blog.

tess: For legal: please attach the transcript and the proposed public attribution (name + title). If they want an embargo we need the calendar date and the person who can sign the permission PDF. I can do faster than usual if those are provided.

cs-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/beaconedge-2026-03-22/transcript.v1.txt

sasha: Attribution: "Hana Park, CTO, BeaconEdge". They declined email in public asset. Hana is fine with headshot attribution: "Photo credit: BeaconEdge".

tess: Good. Send me the signed permission PDF (logo + quote + headshot). Also, are we using any comparative numbers? If we mention "halved latency" include baseline timeframe (e.g., 90-day avg vs. previous infra) or we'll need a supporting note.

jo: We can say "median tail latency improved ~50% vs our prior infra (90-day avg)". I'll confirm exact numbers with Hana and get sign-off on the wording.

omar: Heads-up: we'll add a HubSpot form variant for the case study page to surface webinar interest. Lead flow plan: form -> add property `cs_interest:beaconedge` -> add to list `webinar-invite-qa` -> route to SF queue `CS - BeaconEdge`. Anyone object?

kevin: That works. Can we also add a hidden utm param for campaign attribution? utm_campaign=cs_beaconedge_2026

omar: Yep. I'll include the utm and set cookie expiry for 30d. Also will tag qualified leads `merch:high-touch` when they click the webinar RSVP link.

tess: On embargo: legal needs the exact embargo lift timestamp. Please set the publish date/time here so contract can reference it.

sasha: Proposed publish: 2026-03-31 09:00 PDT (embargo lift). Webcast: tentative webinar 2026-04-14 11:00 PDT.

tess: Noted. I'll draft a one-paragraph release clause and the permission PDF referencing that publish time. Expect redline by Mon COB.

jo: I'll get Hana to sign today. Pinged her in email with the permission PDF attached.

kevin: Draft plan for assets:
- short case study landing (60012 words)
- long form customer story (120015 words)
- 2 social tiles + 1 short clip (30s)
- webinar invite email + landing page

sasha: Nice. Also need ops to ensure page adds HubSpot form variant. Omar, can you add the workflow snippet?

omar: Will do. Example workflow (HubSpot):
```
Trigger: page visit -> if form submitted (beaconedge-cs-form) -> set property cs_interest=beaconedge -> add to list webinar-invite-qa -> notify SF queue
```

kevin: For the hero quote we should A/B test two variants in the first 48h: (A) tech-focused quote above, (B) impact-focused quote: "We launched faster and our engineers spend time building product not babysitting inference."

sasha: Great idea. Add A/B test to the publish checklist.

jo: Hana confirmed the number language and signed the PDF. Uploading now.

cs-bot: Permission PDF uploaded: /permissions/beaconedge/permission-signed-2026-03-22.pdf

tess: Got it. I'll run the redline and post comments here once done. Expect comments by Mon 12:00 PDT.

sasha: Updated action items:
- jo: upload signed permission (done)
- tess: legal redline + publish clause (Mon 12:00 PDT)
- kevin: draft assets + paste link to drive (EOD Fri)
- omar: HubSpot workflow + UTMs + lead routing (this week)
- sasha: set A/B test and embargo calendar entry (today)

kevin: I'll add the draft to GDrive and share link here when ready.

sasha: tagging @here for visibility :rocket: Good work team.

cs-bot: Note: raw recording retained 90 days per policy.
